description: Sixty seconds carrying the three ThermalController fault-injection commands that the firmware implements: a five second out-of-range reading, a three second transmission silence, and a four value sequence-counter skip.

injected_events.description: ThermalController reports a saturated raw temperature of 0x7FFF with node state Degraded and fault code SensorSaturation for 5 seconds. Uptime and the sequence counter keep running.

ThermalController transmits neither THERMAL_DATA nor THERMAL_HEARTBEAT for 3 seconds. The node keeps running, so uptime continues and the sequence counter resumes where it stopped. PowerMonitor traffic is unaffected.
ThermalController advances its sequence counter by 4 extra values before the next transmission, leaving 4 counter values unobserved.
